description: Opt-out dengan panduan untuk Spy Dialer, yang mencantumkan orang berdasarkan nomor telepon. Satu opt-out mencakup setiap nomor telepon yang disimpan.
instructions: Buka https://www.spydialer.com/ and click "Do Not Sell Or Share My Personal Information" at the bottom. Press Start, choose your state, finish the robot check, then add {full_name}, your address, each of these numbers ({all_phones}) and {email}. Press "Opt-Out My Info" and wait for "Your submitted data has been blocked from future sharing". Kemudian tekan "Saya sudah melakukan ini".
